reviewItem.question: For "Added ingress-shim option `--extra-certificate-annotations`, which sets a list of annotation keys to be copied from Ingress-like to resulting Certificate object", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: The ingress-shim component adds a new command-line flag --extra-certificate-annotations that allows specifying annotation keys to be copied from Ingress-like resources to resulting Certificate objects.
